|lore=Captain Mod Terrik, a typical officer of the Desert Sands sandtrooper unit. Fearless and highly motivated. Willing to sacrifice as many troops as necessary. Leader.
|game_text=Power +1 if Stardust or Stolen Data Tapes on table. While with another trooper, attrition against opponent here is +1. During your move phase, when moving with a 'squad' of up to two other stormtroopers, they all move (using landspeed) for 1 Force.
